title: 第十二章 真香
novel_title: 魔头别夺舍了，我们正道快没人了
content_zh:
面对如此众多的同门，小剑仙萧京溪选择了当场宕机。

    大概就是那种系统蓝屏，然后弹出一连串错误提示的状态。

    这种场面对于涉世未深的小剑仙来说果然还是太过刺激了吗!(才怪)

    而季南北只是觉得有些纳闷。

    萧京溪在宗门里的人气果然很高吗?可为什么前段时间没出现这种情况?

    季南北的疑惑是没人能解答了，毕竟当事人正“宕机”中，而周围其他人此刻更像是狂热的追捧者。

    不少师妹挤到前面来，争相和季南北打招呼。“萧师姐好!”

    “师姐现在要去做什么呀?是在散步吗?”

    “师姐可以和我握个手吗!?“

    幸好，季南北还算擅长应对这类场景，并未显出窘态，举止大方得体，一一回应着。

    若说有什么感慨，那大概就是对萧京溪未来的些许担忧吧。

    这孩子......往后要是天天面对这种阵仗，真的能行吗!?

    “哇!师姐对我笑了!她一定喜欢我!”

    “你瞎说!师姐明明是在对我笑!”

    “一边去!师姐可是握了我的手!师姐肯定中意我!”

    聚集的人越来越多了。好在，在事态彻底失控之前，有位长老察觉到此处的异常，过来镇住了场面。

    而季南北则趁着混乱，直接溜走了。

    被安抚下来的众位师妹也逐渐恢复了理智，认错后便各自散去。

    不过许多人又悄悄聚到一处，低声交谈起来。

    “师姐真是神仙般的人物啊!太温柔了!“

    “对啊对啊，以前还觉得萧师姐有点距离感，现在发现，师姐根本就像阳光一样温暖可亲!”

    “我这只手不洗了!“

    但很快，几位实力较强的内门弟子站了出来主持局面。

    “咱们不能这么冒失了，虽然萧师姐人很好，但这样会给师姐添麻烦的!”

    “是啊，这次连长老都出面了，咱们确实有些过火了，得有个规矩!”

    “这样吧，以后每天去跟萧师姐问好的人，要限制数量，而且不能耽搁师姐太长时间!分批进行!”

    其他师妹纷纷赞同。

    毕竟，她们也不想因为自己的缘故，给完美的萧师姐造成困扰。

    于是......一个奇特的“组织”悄然成形。

    而季南北脱身后，跑到了一处僻静之地。

    望着远处翻涌的云海，季南北忍不住笑出了声。

    “怎么样，感觉如何?”
content_en:
Faced with so many fellow disciples, Xiao Jingxi, the young swordsman, chose to shut down his computer on the spot.

    It's probably the kind of state where the system blue screens and then a series of error prompts pop up.

    This kind of scene is really too exciting for the little swordsman who is new to the world! (That’s weird)

    Ji Nanbei just felt a little puzzled.

    Is Xiao Jingxi really very popular in the sect? But why didn't this happen some time ago?

    No one can answer Ji Nanbei's doubts. After all, the person involved is "down", and the others around him are more like fanatical followers at the moment.

    Many junior sisters crowded to the front and rushed to say hello to Ji Nanbei. "Hello, Senior Sister Xiao!"

    "Sister, what are you going to do now? Are you taking a walk?"

    "Senior sister, can you shake my hand!?"

    Fortunately, Ji Nanbei was pretty good at dealing with this kind of scene. He didn't show any embarrassment and behaved generously and appropriately, responding to everything.

    If there is any emotion, it is probably a little worried about Xiao Jingxi's future.

    This kid... can he really do it if he faces this kind of battle every day in the future!?

    "Wow! Senior sister smiled at me! She must like me!"

    "You're talking nonsense! Senior sister is obviously smiling at me!"

    "Let's go! Senior sister shook my hand! Senior sister must like me!"

    More and more people gathered. Fortunately, before the situation completely got out of control, an elder noticed something unusual here and came to calm the situation.

    Ji Nanbei took advantage of the chaos and slipped away.

    The junior sisters who were comforted gradually regained their senses, and after admitting their mistakes, they dispersed.

    However, many people quietly gathered together and started talking in low voices.

    "Senior sister is really a fairy-like figure! So gentle!"

    "Yes, yes, I used to feel that Senior Sister Xiao was a bit distant, but now I realize that Senior Sister is as warm and approachable as the sun!"

    "I won't wash this hand!"

    But soon, several stronger inner disciples stepped forward to take charge of the situation.

    "We can't be so rash. Although Senior Sister Xiao is a very nice person, this will bring trouble to Senior Sister!"

    "Yes, even the elders came forward this time. We have indeed gone too far. There must be rules!"

    "Let's do this. From now on, the number of people who go to say hello to Senior Sister Xiao every day must be limited, and Senior Sister cannot be delayed for too long! Do it in batches!"

    Other junior sisters agreed.

    After all, they didn't want to cause trouble to the perfect Senior Sister Xiao because of themselves.

    So...a peculiar "organization" quietly took shape.

    After Ji Nanbei escaped, he ran to a secluded place.

    Looking at the billowing sea of ​​clouds in the distance, Ji Nanbei couldn't help laughing.

    "How is it, how does it feel?"
